title: Effects of Malalignment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Measure alignment standing and on a long leg film, since supine imaging underestimates it.
Localise the deformity to the femur, the tibia or the joint before planning a correction.
Treat the adduction moment as the quantity alignment is a proxy for.
Treat alignment as the only mechanical variable in this chapter that can be changed by a large amount.
Correct alignment before or with any cartilage or meniscal procedure in a malaligned limb.
Assess slope separately, since it acts on a different mechanism from compartment share.
Confirm the correction radiographically rather than assuming the plan was achieved.
